The strategy is maneuver warfare which can be the same for a vehicle or infantry but it's easier when you have the speed. If you stop to take a flag rock back and forth inside the capture area, if you stand still you will get C4ed. If you have a second monitor keep the Battlelog map open on the second screen, always try to go where the enemy is weak, don't try to take them head on where they are strong. If you see a tank try to stay out of their line of sight until you can get around to their rear, 2 tow missiles/RPG to the back of a tank will kill it.

Know when to run away, if you've taken damage especially if you don't know where it's coming from just disengage and repair. Use the active armor and learn to anticipate when someone is going to shoot you, knowing the timing for reloading a tank round or RPG is important.

It's not easy but you can shoot down a helicopter with a tank, generally speaking you can't with a LAV. If attacked by a helicopter disengage and find cover if you can, if not rush toward them and stay directly below them where they can't shoot you. Take some well timed shots at them and again you probably won't kill it but can do enough damage to get them to disengage.

Beyond that it is just practice, learn to drive backward just as well as you drive forward. Pay attention to what an enemy is doing and try to anticipate his next move. Learn the ballistic arc of the main gun so you can quickly make shots at long range. Always use thermal vision, only switch out briefly to check terrain/judge range/shoot at aircraft etc.
